# Lumindra

> Lumindra (also known as Bali AI Consultant) is an AI consulting and business systems practice in Kerobokan, Bali, led by founder Mark Tulloch. It helps Bali business owners put practical AI, automation and operating systems to work, and offers one-on-one Conscious Systems clarity sessions for founders and leaders. Every system is tested at Sunshooters Bar & Grill, a live sports bar in Kerobokan, before it is recommended to a client. Prices are in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Sessions run in person in Kerobokan, Bali and on Zoom worldwide.

## Key facts
- Founder and lead: Mark Tulloch (Australian-born, based in Bali; 35+ years in hospitality and operations; former COO of Bali Realty)
- Location: Kerobokan, Bali, Indonesia
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821 4402 9645 (Mark replies personally, no forms) | Connect@baliaiconsultant.com
- First step: free 30-minute consultation on WhatsApp, Zoom or in person
- Languages: English
- Not a large agency: work is done directly by Mark, as implementation rather than slide decks

## What Lumindra offers and typical prices (IDR)
### AI and automation (https://lumindra.co/technology)
- Free 30-Minute Consultation: free
- AI Starter Program (4 days, 30 minutes a day, for beginners): Rp 2,000,000
- 18-Minute Hospitality AI System (the daily workflow used at Sunshooters): Rp 2,500,000
- Business WhatsApp Automation (7 to 14 business days, 30-day launch support): from Rp 5,000,000
- Professional Website Builds: from Rp 5,000,000 (Starter), Rp 10,000,000 (Business), Rp 20,000,000 (Premium + AI)
- AI-Powered Business Operating System (staff, SOPs, operations, stock, reports, dashboards): from Rp 10,000,000, monthly support from Rp 2,500,000

### Conscious Systems clarity sessions (https://lumindra.co/human)
- Clarity Mapping Session (90 minutes, one-on-one): Rp 750,000 for locals, Rp 1,500,000 for expats
- Commercial Clarity Mapping (for business owners): from Rp 1,500,000
- Strategic Soul Consulting (for leaders and owners): from Rp 1,500,000
- 5-Step Realignment (five 90-minute sessions): Rp 2,500,000
- Personal Song Creations (custom song from your story): Rp 500,000

### Business Systems Advisory
- Operational review, decision bottleneck analysis and delivery and visibility audit. Ask Mark for scope and price.

## Proof
- Sunshooters Bar & Grill, Kerobokan, Bali is Lumindra's live testing ground: WhatsApp AI agent, operations dashboard, content planning, delivery platform optimisation. Case study: https://lumindra.co/case-study-sunshooters
